test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

SI = (2500 times 6 times 4)/(100)

⇒ SI = 25 × 6 × 4

⇒ SI = 25 × 24

⇒ SI = 600

**∴ The simple interest is ₹600.**
